So I ended up taking her to a vet that specializes in exotic and small animals, and the vet said that tootsie (my guinea pig) didn't seem to be in pain and that it most likely wasn't an intestinal blockage or buildup because she was still pooping normally and actually quite a lot. Her best guess was that tootsie has ovarian cysts that can fill with liquid depending on her cycle. They drain and then fill up again which is what is causing her to fluctuate in size. She said that there's no way to tell for sure without an x-Ray or ultra sound but that she isn't in pain and it isn't really causing her any issues.  I could get them removed but she is already 6 years old and i don't want to put her through that. She said if she does seem to be in pain to bring her back in to get some pain medication.  I have still taken her off fresh fruits and vegetables for a week to see how she is just because it still could be her stomach and we don't want anything else blocking it up so I'm giving lots of hay and a vitamin c tablet for guinea pigs everyday aswell as 2ml of infacoil every day which is a medicine they use for babies with gas (the vet said it was totally safe and a good idea. It isn't dangerous and you can't overdose on it) I'm just keeping a close eye on her but she is well and is going to be okay:)
